question.value: Provide accurate laboratory rotational spectroscopy of thioformamide and use it to search for the molecule toward Sgr B2(N) with ALMA ReMoCA data.

evidence.quote: The aim of this study is to provide accurate spectroscopic parameters and rotational transition frequencies for thioformamide to enable astronomical searches for this molecule using radio telescope arrays at millimeter wavelengths.
This paper makes use of the following ALMA data: ADS/JAO.ALMA#2016.1.00074.S.

frequencies_and_spectral_setup.value: 84.1-114.4 GHz fully covered, 488 kHz resolution (1.7 to 1.3 km/s)

evidence.quote: the frequency range from 84.1 GHz to 114.4 GHz was fully covered with a spectral resolution of 488 kHz (1.7 to 1.3 km s$^{-1}$).

The interferometric observations achieved an angular resolution (half-power beam width, HPBW) varying between $\sim$0.3$\ensuremath{''}$ and $\sim$0.8$\ensuremath{''}$, with a median value of 0.6$\ensuremath{''}$.
The rms sensitivity ranged between 0.35 mJy beam$^{-1}$ and 1.1 mJy beam$^{-1}$, with a median value of 0.8 mJy beam$^{-1}$.

provided.value: Laboratory rotational spectrum of thioformamide, 150-660 GHz

evidence.quote: The rotational spectrum of thioformamide was measured and analyzed in the frequency range 150 to 660 GHz using the Lille spectrometer.

analysis_steps.goal: LTE modelling of methanol, isotopologs and methanethiol toward Sgr B2(N1S)

method.value: Fit LTE synthetic spectra with Weeds; population diagrams used to set temperatures

evidence.quote: We modeled the spectra of Sgr B2(N1S) and Sgr B2(N2) with the software Weeds (cite: Maret11) under the assumption of local thermodynamic equilibrium (LTE)

key_parameters.value: Five parameters per species: size, column density, temperature, line width, velocity offset

evidence.quote: Each species was modeled with a set of five parameters: size of the emitting region ($\theta_{\rm s}$), column density ($N$), temperature ($T_{\rm rot}$), line width ($\Delta V$), and velocity offset ($V_{\rm off}$)

key_parameters.value: Source size 2" assumed; T = 230 K for methanol, 250 K for methanethiol

evidence.quote: We adopted a temperature of 230 K to model the emission of methanol and its isotopologs.
$V_{\rm sys}=62$ km s$^{-1}$ for Sgr B2(N1S) and $V_{\rm sys}= 74$ km s$^{-1}$ for Sgr B2(N2)

validation.value: Gaussian fit to integrated intensity maps gives mean size ~2.2" consistent with 2" assumption

evidence.quote: A two-dimensional Gaussian fit to the integrated intensity maps of the least contaminated transitions of methanethiol yields a mean size of $\sim$2.2$\ensuremath{''}$

analysis_steps.goal: Derive thioformamide column density upper limits

method.value: Compare ReMoCA spectra to LTE spectra of thioformamide using formamide's parameters, column density as only free parameter

evidence.quote: keeping only the column density of thioformamide as a free parameter. We found no evidence for emission of thioformamide toward either source.

used_for.value: LTE modelling of Sgr B2 spectra

evidence.quote: We modeled the spectra of Sgr B2(N1S) and Sgr B2(N2) with the software Weeds (cite: Maret11)

findings_qualitative.value: Thioformamide not detected; at least ~700 (N1S) and ~900 (N2) times less abundant than formamide, versus methanethiol ~40 and 120 times less than methanol.

evidence.quote: thioformamide is at least $\sim$700 and $\sim$900 times less abundant than formamide in Sgr B2(N1S) and Sgr B2(N2), respectively.

claims.hypothesis: Is thioformamide detectable in Sgr B2(N) hot cores given its oxygen analog formamide?
claims.experiment: Compared ReMoCA spectra with LTE models of thioformamide using formamide parameters
claims.finding: Thioformamide is nearly three orders of magnitude less abundant than formamide

evidence.quote: Thioformamide was not detected toward the hot cores Sgr B2(N1S) and Sgr B2(N2).

claims.hypothesis: Why is the S/O ratio lower for thioformamide/formamide than methanethiol/methanol?
claims.experiment: Interpret with Garrod et al. 2020 chemical model
claims.result: CS/CO falls by ~12x between 4e5 and 9e5 yr
claims.finding: Late-time grain formation of thioformamide limited by depressed CS abundance

evidence.quote: The different behavior shown by methanethiol versus thioformamide may be caused by the preferential formation of the latter (on grains) at late times and low temperatures, when CS abundances are depressed.

limitations_admitted.value: No dedicated chemical network for thioformamide exists, so no direct model comparison.

evidence.quote: To our knowledge, no networks exist for the production of interstellar thioformamide.

referee_caveats_inferred: Upper limits depend on assuming formamide's excitation parameters apply to thioformamide
Interpretation rests on a model not tailored to sulfur species
